Stem library

165 candidates, one curve per tight square. Nothing here is in a vase; this is the catalogue.

How to use it. Every card has an S-number and its source. Tell the sheet which S-numbers to promote and they can be moved into flowers.html with their own vases. The curves are drawn at their own scale and orientation; the sheet applies the rotation, the 7 in (or 60 mm) height and the vase placement.

The four groups with numbers are the two existing sources of exact data (generators, Euler), the spiral-turns clothoids, the recovered LAC spines, and four gestures. The named-curve group is there because a loop or a drop can be a stem; the LAC group is there because the soft S is the missing middle.
